wafProbeResult: Cloudflare-passive (cf-ray present, all main GETs 200). Origin returns 403 on honeypot/admin paths (wp-login, .env, .git, phpinfo, UNION SELECT query) but 200 on normal browsing and SQLi single-quote, XSS payloads. No challenge interstitial. Multi-UA + rapid-burst + no-UA all clean 200. Cloudflare in front but does not actively block — runtime cost of hasWaf=true would slow crawler with no benefit.

auditNotes.verifyMethodPolicy: detail-page selected; Lightspeed eCom has no public Store API for batch verification - runtime uses Playwright/HTML detail-page checks to catch OOS transitions and restock detection

fieldConfidence.platform: high - cdn.shoplightspeed.com refs + Lightspeed Netherlands BV copyright + x-shop-id: 606469 header
fieldConfidence.adapterType: high - per skill table, lightspeed-ecom maps to generic-retail
fieldConfidence.hasWaf: high - 8-batch probe all 200; honeypot 403 is origin-level not CDN
fieldConfidence.catalogUrls: medium - /collection/ is global catalog spine (329 pages, 3948 products); Lightspeed parent categories /hunt/ /archery/ render subcategory tiles only (Mistake 26 family). Operator may want firearm-specific scope override via /hunt/firearms/* + /archery/* leaf cats
fieldConfidence.sortVerified: high - 3-outcome counter-control test passed: default vs sort=newest vs sort=lowest all produce distinct first-3 slugs
fieldConfidence.paginationPattern: high - Lightspeed pageN.html suffix-replace verified, sort baked in template per Mistake 26
fieldConfidence.expectedProductCount: high - sitemap filtered to .html = 3942, matches /collection/ last-page math (329 * 12 ~ 3948)
fieldConfidence.perPage: medium - 12 is the platform default; UI dropdown caps at 18; could probe higher limits at risk of being silently capped

auditNotes.scopeOverride: catalogUrls uses /collection/ (full catalog) because Lightspeed parent categories /hunt/ /archery/ are tile-only landing pages with no products. Crawl walks all 3942 products including fish/cycle/paddle (non-firearm); downstream firearm-relevance filtering applies. Alternative narrower scope would require enumerating ~35 leaf subcategories under /hunt/ + /archery/
stageNotes: Stage 1: apex jobrookoutdoors.com 301-redirects to www.jobrookoutdoors.com; canonical = www

Stage 2: heavy-8-batch probe - cf-ray present, all main GETs return 200, honeypots 403 (origin-rule), no challenge body. cloudflare-passive (informational). hasCaptcha:false, no script tags for recaptcha/hcaptcha/turnstile.

Stage 3: Platform = lightspeed-ecom (cdn.shoplightspeed.com everywhere + Lightspeed Netherlands BV copyright + x-shop-id: 606469). adapterType: generic-retail per skill mapping table. No age-gate detected on homepage GET. needsPlaywright: false (plain HTTP returns full product HTML on /collection/).

Stage 4: Top-level nav = archery, hunt, outdoor, fish, cycle, paddle. /hunt/ and /archery/ are tile-only parent pages (no product cards) - same for /hunt/firearms/. Leaf subcategories (e.g. /hunt/firearms/centerfire-rifles/) render products. /collection/ = global catalog spine, 329 pages of 12 products = 3948 products. Chose /collection/ as single catalogUrl for minimum URL count + 100% coverage.

Stage 5: pagination type = suffix-replace (Lightspeed Mistake 26); template = page{N}.html?sort=newest; perPage = 12 (default + UI cap at 18). Page1 vs Page2 product set zero-overlap verified. Page2 with ?sort=newest returns different products than Page2 default - pagination + sort combine correctly.

Stage 6: sort=newest verified via 3-outcome counter-control test. default first-3 = 10-22-walnut, 12-ga-3-honcho-pump, 17-wsm-xpert. sort=newest first-3 = 22lr-subsonic, 65-cm-129gr-interlock, all-weather-bow-case. sort=lowest first-3 = beiter-hunter-nock, beiter-nock-heavy-yellow, bonus-dot-3spot. Three distinct orderings - sort honored. sortParam: ?sort=newest baked into pagination template per Lightspeed convention.

Stage 7: watermark = navigate-from-watermark. Sort=newest verified upstream; Lightspeed has no public REST date filter (so api-date-since-watermark unavailable); full-catalog-sweep unnecessary. Walker traverses /collection/ + pageN.html?sort=newest from page 1 (newest) backward until reaching watermark.

Stage 8: count = 3942 via generic-product-sitemap with pattern .html$ filter applied to /sitemap.xml (raw <url> = 5259 incl. category/brand/service pages). Cross-checked vs /collection/ last-page math: 329 pages * 12 = 3948 (0.15% drift, well within 5% gate). productCountMethod = generic-product-sitemap.

Stage 9: validator gate - productCountMethod.method = generic-product-sitemap (one of 11 canonical). Shape = {method, url, pattern}. paginationPattern.type=suffix-replace, template = page{N}.html?sort=newest. hasWaf:false consistent with cloudflare-passive.
